LESSON: SIGN READING 6.2.1 FLUENCY

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 6
Topic 6.2: Sign Reading 6.2.1 Fluency
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Sign Reading 6.2.1 Fluency, part of Strand 6 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade two ENGLISH LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

Key inquiry question: How can we improve our reading speed? 2. How do we show feelings and emotions when reading?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Sign Reading 6.2.1 Fluency together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Communication and collaboration: Teamwork, as the learner participates in Reader Theater with peers to recite poems.

● Learning to learn: Learning independently as the learner practise sign reading sentences containing decodable and non-decodable words.

Values:
Unity: Cooperation as the learner works collaboratively with peers during reader’s theatre.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
Life skills: Effective communication as the learner participates in reader’s theatre in reciting using signs poems related to the theme.
